headline: Extends a 2000 law on federal doctors' extra pay to doctors in the Foreign Service and CIA retirement systems.
what_it_does: The Federal Physicians Comparability Allowance Amendments of 2000 changed rules for the extra pay some government doctors get to help match private-sector salaries, including how it can count toward retirement benefits. This order applies those same rules to doctors covered by the Foreign Service and CIA retirement systems. The title does not give further details.

who_it_affects.group: Government doctors in the Foreign Service retirement systems
who_it_affects.how: The 2000 rules on physicians' extra pay now apply to their retirement system.

who_it_affects.group: CIA doctors in the CIA Retirement and Disability System
who_it_affects.how: The 2000 rules on physicians' extra pay now apply to their retirement system.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 23, 2003; no separate effective date is given in the title.
